usedFor: Amazon Seller Central holds your orders and refunds, and Google Sheets receives them through “Update Multiple Rows”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Amazon Seller Central, then “Update Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each new order, filtered by marketplace, status or fulfillment, updates sheet rows so your tracking sheet stays current.

watchOut: “New Refund” in Amazon Seller Central is polling, so refunds reach the sheet after a scheduled check.
